title: Easy and the best streak counter.
body: I really wanted to try it once then after using it I really found so useful and easy to track my streaks. The best and simple app. I loved this. I’m maintaining a streak now it’s been 11 days now and I’m still on my big way. I added this to my widgets which is really helping me to do my works irrespective of my mood. I’m being so disciplined and eager to maintain a streak. A really good app. Thanks for the developers and company etc etc who worked for this. You all are great . Love you from Hyderabad.
author: Dia_shriii
